title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Cable Magnets
description: Acts as primary owner of cable magnet hardware for SPARC and ARC tokamak devices, leading structural mechanics and heat transfer design.

title: Senior R&D Electromagnetic Analysis Engineer
description: Performs advanced non-linear electromagnetic simulations and multi-objective optimization for high-temperature superconducting tokamak magnets.

title: Principal Scientist - Radio Frequency Plasma Heating
description: Leads modeling, testing, and commissioning of the multi-megawatt SPARC ICRH antenna and RF network systems to deliver core plasma auxiliary heating.

title: Molten Salt Engineer
description: Supports R&D on high-temperature molten salt systems for tritium breeding blankets and heat extraction in commercial ARC fusion power plants.

title: Principal Nuclear Materials Engineer
description: Directs engineering choices on neutron radiation effects across structural metals and magnet coils in Helion pulsed fusion generators.

title: Senior Multiphysics Modeling Engineer
description: Builds and validates coupled multiphysics models using the MOOSE simulation environment to analyze high-temperature ceramics and plasma-facing components.

title: Power Electronics Engineer
description: Designs, prototypes, and commissions high-voltage, high-speed power electronics for Helion magnetic compression stages and energy recapture circuits.

title: Principal Experimental Scientist - RF
description: Leads high-power RF plasma source development and experimental diagnostic campaigns to optimize plasma formation for Helion FRC fusion injectors.

title: Completions Engineer
description: Plans and executes multistage stimulation and completion programs for horizontal enhanced geothermal wells operating under extreme thermal stresses.

title: Reservoir Engineer, Modeling
description: Develops calibrated reservoir simulation and fracture models to predict heat breakthrough and pressure support across commercial EGS geothermal well doublets.

title: Seismologist
description: Analyzes microseismicity and manages real-time seismic traffic light protocols during high-pressure reservoir stimulation across Fervo geothermal plants.

title: Senior Drilling Engineer
description: Engineers deep well construction programs in hard crystalline basement rock, integrating rotary drilling with novel thermal millimeter-wave systems.

title: Lead Reservoir Engineer
description: Leads reservoir physics, fracture characterization, and production modeling for superhot, deep rock reservoirs targeted by Quaise 10-20 km deep drilling.

title: Electromagnetics Engineer
description: Designs and tests millimeter-wave transmission waveguides transmitting megawatt-scale gyrotron energy downhole to vaporize hard crystalline rock.

title: Senior Neutronics Engineer - Isotope Production
description: Executes core neutronics modeling and irradiation target designs within Oklo fast spectrum reactors to optimize clean baseload power with radioisotopes.

title: Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer
description: Performs transient safety analysis and thermal-hydraulic modeling to evaluate natural circulation cooling in fast microreactors.

title: Sodium Test Engineer
description: Operates experimental molten sodium test loops at Oklo Idaho facility, validating valves and electromagnetic pumps under fast reactor coolant conditions.

title: Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer
description: Develops formal Criticality Safety Evaluations (CSEs) and licensing documentation under NRC 10 CFR 70 for Oklo commercial fuel fabrication facilities.

title: Principal Engineer, Nuclear Analysis
description: Leads nuclear core design, neutronics calculations, and transient safety analysis for the 345 MWe sodium-cooled Natrium demonstration reactor plant.

title: Senior Engineer, Thermal Hydraulic Test
description: Executes thermal-hydraulic experimental campaigns and code validation in laboratory test loops to qualify Natrium reactor heat exchanger components.
